_comment: Thumbnail directions tuned on actual channel data (views per cover style). WINNERS: mask/face + fire/ember/gold glow (ZALIMBA 1822, MALZ 963, JISANI 660, LUKUTAI 378, VOKALI 309, JARUNA 239, FUKARI). LOSERS removed: landscapes/no-subject (LUMASI 15), dim candle-only scenes (MAKARI 42), dark-on-dark (LUMINA). All six variants stay in the proven fire/gold/mask family; rotation (never twice in a row, max 2 in last 6) keeps them from looking copy-pasted.

directions.subject: A carved African ceremonial mask surrounded by candles and drifting EMBERS, warm firelight licking its features, filling 75% of the frame.
directions.image_rules:
1. STYLE: ultra-detailed photorealistic, ritual-scene cinematography.
2. PALETTE: blazing ORANGE-GOLD firelight on dark wood, glowing embers floating.
3. LIGHT: the fire is BRIGHT — the mask glows hot against the dark, high contrast.
4. COMPOSITION: mask large and centered, instantly readable at 200px.
5. MOOD: ritualistic, hypnotic, alive.
FORBIDDEN: dim candle-only gloom, murky dark-on-dark, landscapes, small subject, neon blue.

directions.subject: A magnificent carved African mask with polished GOLD inlay, cowrie-shell crown and dark afro hair, facing the viewer, filling 75% of the frame.
directions.image_rules:
1. STYLE: ultra-detailed photorealistic render, museum-artifact quality.
2. PALETTE: radiant GOLD + rich dark wood, faint glowing tribal pattern behind.
3. LIGHT: strong warm key light — the gold BLAZES off the dark background.
4. COMPOSITION: centered, huge, iconic.
5. MOOD: majestic, premium — luxury album cover.
FORBIDDEN: murkiness, dim lighting, small subject, clutter, neon, cartoon.

directions.subject: A fierce, intense African war mask bathed in dramatic RED-ORANGE fire glow, sparks in the air, filling 75% of the frame.
directions.image_rules:
1. STYLE: cinematic, high-drama photorealism.
2. PALETTE: burning RED-ORANGE dominating, deep shadows for contrast, hot highlights.
3. LIGHT: strong fiery glow from below/side — dramatic and BRIGHT, never murky.
4. COMPOSITION: mask huge, aggressive angle, eyes catching light.
5. MOOD: fierce, powerful, adrenaline.
FORBIDDEN: underexposed gloom, cold colors, landscapes, cartoon.

directions.subject: An intense close-up of a young African warrior's face with metallic GOLD war paint streaks, piercing bright eyes looking straight at the viewer, filling 80% of the frame.
directions.image_rules:
1. STYLE: hyper-realistic cinematic close-up, razor sharp.
2. PALETTE: warm bronze skin + brilliant GOLD paint, near-black background.
3. LIGHT: powerful warm key light — face BRIGHT, magnetic eye contact.
4. COMPOSITION: extreme close-up, eyes on the upper third.
5. MOOD: fierce, hypnotic, impossible to scroll past.
FORBIDDEN: underexposed face, murky shadows, busy background, neon, cartoon.

directions.subject: A regal African king mask wearing an ornate GOLD-and-jewel crown, ember glow and warm haze behind, filling 75% of the frame.
directions.image_rules:
1. STYLE: ultra-detailed photorealistic, royal-portrait grandeur.
2. PALETTE: deep gold + warm ember orange + one ruby-red jewel accent on near-black.
3. LIGHT: warm spotlight from above — crown and gold detail SPARKLE.
4. COMPOSITION: symmetric, towering, centered.
5. MOOD: royal, commanding, timeless.
FORBIDDEN: dimness, low contrast, landscapes, small subject, neon.

directions.subject: A regal African queen with a gleaming gold beaded headdress and gold face paint, luminous skin, eyes closed in trance, filling 70% of the frame.
directions.image_rules:
1. STYLE: hyper-realistic cinematic portrait, glossy magazine quality.
2. PALETTE: glowing bronze skin + brilliant GOLD jewelry + one deep CRIMSON accent, near-black background.
3. LIGHT: dramatic golden rim light both sides — face BRIGHT and dimensional.
4. COMPOSITION: face large, centered, sharp.
5. MOOD: divine, magnetic.
FORBIDDEN: dark murky tones, underexposed face, busy background, neon, flat illustration.
